entries.format: decimal TCP port, 1-65535
entries.description: Local or self-hosted service listen port.
entries.failureBehavior: Defaults to each service's documented port; Vercel supplies its own port.

entries.format: bind hostname or IP
entries.description: Local or self-hosted service bind address.
entries.failureBehavior: Defaults to 0.0.0.0.

entries.format: non-empty UTF-8 display name
entries.description: OpenAPI and service display name.
entries.failureBehavior: Uses Control API when absent.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS origin; localhost HTTP is allowed locally
entries.description: OpenAPI server URL.
entries.failureBehavior: The OpenAPI document omits its servers field.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS issuer origin
entries.description: Auth issuer accepted by API and protected Content reads.
entries.failureBehavior: Readiness fails and authenticated requests return an unavailable response.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS URL to Auth JWKS; localhost HTTP is allowed locally
entries.description: Public signing-key endpoint for JWT verification.
entries.failureBehavior: Readiness fails or bearer verification is unavailable.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS origin used as JWT audience
entries.description: API OAuth resource and JWT audience.
entries.failureBehavior: API readiness fails and bearer verification rejects configuration.

entries.format: PostgreSQL connection URL, with TLS required for hosted databases
entries.description: Core authoring and publication database connection.
entries.failureBehavior: Core routes and migration commands fail closed.

entries.format: relative object key without a leading slash or path traversal
entries.description: Mutable selector for the published Content release.
entries.failureBehavior: Defaults to realm-content/current.json.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS URL to Content internal publication endpoint
entries.description: API destination for immutable Content release publication.
entries.failureBehavior: Publication returns an unavailable error when absent or invalid.

entries.format: same opaque high-entropy token on API and Content
entries.description: Service authentication for API to Content publication.
entries.failureBehavior: Publication is rejected with 401 or unavailable status.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS URL to Realm internal revalidation endpoint
entries.description: API destination for post-publication cache invalidation.
entries.failureBehavior: Publication is not reported successful when revalidation fails.

entries.format: long random shared HMAC secret
entries.description: HMAC key shared by API and Realm revalidation handler.
entries.failureBehavior: Revalidation cannot be authenticated.

entries.format: PostgreSQL connection URL, with TLS required for hosted databases
entries.description: Better Auth identity, account, session and security database.
entries.failureBehavior: Auth readiness fails and database-backed requests cannot run.

entries.format: non-empty UTF-8 service name
entries.description: Auth and TOTP issuer display name.
entries.failureBehavior: Better Auth uses its default display name.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS origin; localhost HTTP is allowed locally
entries.description: Canonical Auth base URL and OAuth provider activation switch.
entries.failureBehavior: OAuth provider is disabled when absent.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS issuer URL
entries.description: Issuer claim emitted in Auth JWTs.
entries.failureBehavior: Auth readiness fails and emitted/accepted issuer configuration is incomplete.

entries.format: comma-separated absolute resource URLs
entries.description: JWT audience resources accepted by downstream services.
entries.failureBehavior: Auth readiness fails when the list is absent.

entries.format: long random secret, unique to the Auth deployment
entries.description: Better Auth signing and encryption secret.
entries.failureBehavior: Auth readiness fails; the development fallback is not a production configuration.

entries.format: comma-separated exact origins, including scheme and no path
entries.description: Origins allowed by Better Auth for browser requests.
entries.failureBehavior: Auth readiness fails and unlisted browser origins are rejected.

entries.format: comma-separated absolute resource URLs
entries.description: OAuth provider resource indicators exposed to clients.
entries.failureBehavior: Auth readiness fails when the list is absent.

entries.format: WebAuthn relying-party hostname, without scheme or path
entries.description: WebAuthn relying-party identifier.
entries.failureBehavior: Passkey registration/authentication and Auth readiness fail.

entries.format: exact HTTPS origin matching the browser passkey origin
entries.description: WebAuthn origin accepted by Auth.
entries.failureBehavior: Passkey operations are rejected or unavailable.

entries.format: non-empty UTF-8 display name
entries.description: Content service and OpenAPI display name.
entries.failureBehavior: Uses Published Content when absent.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS origin
entries.description: OpenAPI server URL for the Content service.
entries.failureBehavior: The OpenAPI document omits its servers field.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS resource URL used as JWT audience
entries.description: Content protected-read OAuth resource and JWT audience.
entries.failureBehavior: Content readiness fails and protected reads cannot authenticate.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS S3-compatible endpoint URL
entries.description: Object storage endpoint for published Content objects.
entries.failureBehavior: Content readiness and reads return not ready.

entries.format: provider region identifier
entries.description: Object storage region passed to the S3 client.
entries.failureBehavior: Content storage cannot be constructed.

entries.format: boolean string: true/false (false selects virtual-hosted style)
entries.description: S3 addressing mode switch for the configured endpoint.
entries.failureBehavior: Defaults to path-style addressing.

entries.format: read-only object-storage access key ID
entries.description: Object storage credential for Content reads and publication verification.
entries.failureBehavior: Content storage is not ready.

entries.format: read-only object-storage secret access key
entries.description: Object storage secret paired with S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.
entries.failureBehavior: Content storage is not ready.

entries.format: bucket name, without protocol or slash
entries.description: Private bucket containing immutable Content release objects.
entries.failureBehavior: Content readiness and reads return not ready.

entries.format: long random secret unique to Console
entries.description: Console opaque-session encryption and signing key.
entries.failureBehavior: Session creation and validation fail closed.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS Auth issuer origin
entries.description: Issuer used to validate the OIDC ID token.
entries.failureBehavior: OIDC callback validation fails.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS Auth OAuth authorization URL
entries.description: Browser redirect destination for OIDC authorization.
entries.failureBehavior: Login cannot start.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS Auth OAuth token URL
entries.description: Server-side authorization-code exchange destination.
entries.failureBehavior: OIDC callback cannot create a session.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS Auth userinfo URL
entries.description: Server-side OIDC userinfo destination.
entries.failureBehavior: OIDC callback rejects incomplete identity claims.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS Auth JWKS URL
entries.description: Signing keys used to validate the OIDC ID token.
entries.failureBehavior: OIDC callback validation fails.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS Auth RP-initiated logout URL
entries.description: Auth logout endpoint used after Console session deletion.
entries.failureBehavior: Logout cannot complete the provider-side session step.

entries.format: OAuth client identifier issued by Auth
entries.description: Console OAuth client identifier.
entries.failureBehavior: Authorization and token exchange fail.

entries.format: OAuth client secret issued by Auth
entries.description: Console OAuth client credential used only by the BFF.
entries.failureBehavior: Token exchange fails; the value must never enter browser code.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS Console callback URL registered in Auth
entries.description: Exact OIDC authorization-code callback.
entries.failureBehavior: Auth rejects the callback or the code exchange fails.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS Console signed-out URL registered in Auth
entries.description: Exact post-logout landing URL.
entries.failureBehavior: Auth logout redirect is rejected.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS resource URL requested for the API token
entries.description: OAuth resource indicator for Console API calls.
entries.failureBehavior: The issued token is not scoped for the Control API.

entries.format: space-separated OAuth scopes
entries.example: openid profile email content:read content:write content:publish
entries.description: Scopes requested by the Console OAuth client.
entries.failureBehavior: Uses the built-in content/assets/integrations/jobs scope set.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS API origin without path, query, or hash
entries.description: Server-side Control API origin for the BFF.
entries.failureBehavior: Console readiness and BFF requests fail closed.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS Upstash REST URL
entries.description: Distributed session and rate-limit store endpoint.
entries.failureBehavior: Console uses process-local session/rate-limit state.

entries.format: Upstash REST bearer token paired with the REST URL
entries.description: Distributed session and rate-limit store credential.
entries.failureBehavior: Console uses process-local session/rate-limit state.

entries.format: boolean string: 1/0 or true/false
entries.description: Allows trusted forwarded client headers for rate-limit keys.
entries.failureBehavior: Defaults off; Vercel's managed proxy is handled by platform context.

entries.format: feature flag: 1 enables, 0 disables
entries.description: Browser-visible switch for Vercel Analytics.
entries.failureBehavior: Analytics is not mounted unless the value is exactly 1.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS origin allowed in production CSP script-src
entries.description: Analytics script origin added to the Console CSP.
entries.failureBehavior: No extra script origin is added.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS origin allowed in production CSP connect-src
entries.description: Analytics connection origin added to the Console CSP.
entries.failureBehavior: No extra connection origin is added.
